seed_one_rule: repeat highest validation macro-AP frozen and highest validation macro-AP eligible nonfrozen on the two remaining seeds; ties by mode and normalizer
architecture_rule: choose the finalist with highest mean validation macro-AP across all three registered seeds; ties prefer frozen then lexical
checkpoint_rule: select the middle seed by validation macro-AP, ties by seed number; no test or calibration metrics
candidate_thresholds: fit on CODE calibration per parent protocol
deep_gate: execute if best same-normalization partial validation macro-F1 at 0.5 falls short of frozen by +0.03; otherwise only on documented cross-source forgetting
scope: new within-CODE comparison on matched ECG, not independent confirmation or a replacement for PR #6
